info.description: CK Mini Apps / Pouring Pounds APIs, built 1:1 from the official doc (31 endpoints). Switch BASE between staging (ckapistaging.lmssecure.com/v1) and the mini-app gateway (ckminapps.com/v1). Run order: 1 → 2 (paste OTP) → 4 → 5 → 7 → 9 last. Folders 3, 6, 8 write real data: test account only.
